paragraphs.source_en: At today's gathering I met a certain Mr. So-and-so for the first time. They say he was once a man much given to dissipation. Sure enough, at a glance one sees he is an old hand at the pleasures of the town. Possessing such a disposition, he naturally attracts women's favor. Thus rather than say that Mr. So-and-so is dissipated by nature, it would be better to say that he was driven into dissipation despite himself. That would be the more fitting way to put it. I hear his wife was formerly a geisha; how enviable indeed. In truth, most of those who speak ill of dissipated men lack the capacity for dissipation themselves. At the same time, among those who pride themselves on being men of the world, many likewise lack the qualifications for such a life. They are not compelled by circumstance, yet force themselves into the role all the same. Such people, like my watercolor paintings, need give no one concern; in the end they will never amount to anything. And yet they complacently regard themselves as seasoned connoisseurs of pleasure. If the argument holds that merely drinking at restaurants or stepping into a assignation house makes one a man of the world, then I too may be counted a watercolor painter. Just as my watercolors are better left unpainted, a rustic boor ignorant of the rules of dissipation is far nobler than a fool who fancies himself an old hand at it.

paragraphs.source_zh: 在今天的聚会上第一次遇到某某。据说他曾是个喜欢寻花问柳的人。果然，一见便知他是嫖妓老手。由于他具有这种禀性，自然招引女人的喜欢。所以与其说是某某放荡成性，倒不如说他是身不由己而放荡的。这样说才更为恰当。听说他的老婆原是个艺妓，真令人羡慕啊。其实，那些说别人放荡的人，多半自己是缺少放荡本事的。同时以放荡家自居的那些人中，也有许多人是不具备放荡资格的。他们并非身不由己，却硬是打肿脸充胖子。这些人，就像我画的水彩画一样，用不着担心，终究是成不了气候的。尽管如此，他们却以嫖妓老手自居。如果这个道理成立——只要到酒馆喝喝酒，或涉足一下“待合”就可称为嫖妓老手，那么我也可以算得上水彩画家了。正像我的水彩画以不画为佳一样，那些不懂嫖妓规矩的乡下土包子，比起以嫖妓“老手”自居的蠢人来，反高尚得多。

paragraphs.source_en: I cannot quite assent to this theory of the man of the world. Moreover, as a teacher and model for others, my master ought not to utter such foolish thoughts as envying a man for having taken a geisha as his wife. Still, his eye for judging his own watercolor paintings is perfectly sound. Although my master possesses this much self-knowledge, his conceit is by no means easily rooted out. Two days later, in his diary for December fourth, he wrote the following:

paragraphs.source_zh: 我不大赞成这种“嫖妓老手论”。同时，主人为人师表，不应该说出羡慕别人娶艺妓为妻的这种愚蠢想法来。不过，他对自己的水彩画的鉴别眼力，倒是极正确的。尽管主人如此有自知之明，但他的自负心，却很难根除。间隔两天，在十二月四日的日记上，他写道：

paragraphs.source_en: Last night I dreamed that, thinking my attempts at watercolor painting would never come to anything, I had tossed the picture aside, and someone had set it in a splendid frame and hung it above the transom. Once it was framed, even I felt that the picture had suddenly become skillful, and I was exceedingly pleased. I gazed at it alone for a long while, thinking it really was quite a fine thing. Just then day broke, and I awoke; with the sunlight on the blinds, the reality that the painting was as poor as ever became perfectly clear.

units.source_en: Last night I dreamed that, thinking my attempts at watercolor painting would never come to anything, I had tossed the picture aside, and someone had set it in a splendid frame and hung it above the transom.
units.source_zh: 昨天夜里做了一个梦，我觉得自己学画水彩画画不出名堂来，便把画的画扔在一边，不知谁把它镶进一个漂亮的镜框里悬挂在“格窗”上方。

units.source_en: Once it was framed, even I felt that the picture had suddenly become skillful, and I was exceedingly pleased.
units.source_zh: 装进镜框一看，连我自己也觉得这幅画一下子漂亮起来了，真高兴。

units.source_en: I gazed at it alone for a long while, thinking it really was quite a fine thing.
units.source_zh: 我独自久久欣赏着，觉得这幅画蛮够意思的。

units.source_en: Just then day broke, and I awoke; with the sunlight on the blinds, the reality that the painting was as poor as ever became perfectly clear.
units.source_zh: 就在这时，天亮了，我也醒来了，而那幅画拙劣如旧的现实，也随着白日映帘，变得一清二楚了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 昨天夜里做了一个梦，我觉得自己学画水彩画画不出名堂来，便把画的画扔在一边，不知谁把它镶进一个漂亮的镜框里悬挂在“格窗”上方。装进镜框一看，连我自己也觉得这幅画一下子漂亮起来了，真高兴。我独自久久欣赏着，觉得这幅画蛮够意思的。就在这时，天亮了，我也醒来了，而那幅画拙劣如旧的现实，也随着白日映帘，变得一清二楚了。

paragraphs.source_en: It appears that even in his dreams my master cannot shake his lingering attachment to watercolor painting. In that case, naturally this old pedagogue cannot become a watercolor painter, nor even the so-called man of the world of whom he speaks.

units.source_zh: 看来，主人连睡梦里也对水彩画恋恋不舍。

paragraphs.source_zh: 看来，主人连睡梦里也对水彩画恋恋不舍。如此说来，水彩画家理所当然不可能成为这位老夫子自己所说的“老手”啦。
